run_params.method: Weighted bootstrap resample (with replacement) of analytical embeddings using trimmed IPW weights as sampling probabilities. Refit GMM(k=7) on bootstrap sample. Predict labels on original embeddings. ARI vs original.

interpretation: ARI = 0.657 (moderate agreement; below the >0.8 high-agreement threshold). Regime SIZES shift substantially under IPW reweighting (e.g., R1 stable-employment approximately halves; R2 employment-trap approximately doubles). Regime IDENTITIES persist (ARI > 0.5). The pattern is consistent with attrition preferentially affecting individuals classifiable as employment-trap (R2); reweighting brings them back into the sample and inflates R2 prevalence. The unweighted R2 prevalence is therefore likely UNDERSTATED, which strengthens the employment-trap finding rather than undermining it.
